messages:
adrian: quick heads-up - partner integration created a bunch of service accounts and their requests are getting routed to the org-default project. Leads to quota dusting and surprise billing. anyone seen this pattern?
kai: haven't seen that exact combo. we treat any key without a project claim as org-fallback, which seems to be the root cause. partners often mint keys without claims.
lina: product note: partners expect sandboxing. We should avoid silently attributing to prod projects.
marco: options: (1) refuse attribution unless token has project claim (projectless but tracked) (2) auto-create a partner-sandbox project under the partner org (3) honor a partner header X-Partner-Integration and map to a partner-specific billing bucket.
adi: adrian: typo - "adi" -> actually adrian. prefer (3) if partner explicitly sets header, otherwise mark project=null and surface in console.
kai: implementationally: add `routing.reason=partner_integration` and `routing.project=null` when no claim + header absent. emit metric `requests.partner_unattributed`.
lina: console UX: add a partner-usage tile and a banner for org admins: "Partner integration traffic is un-attributed. Map to project or enable partner sandboxing." Also a one-click mapping flow to map existing keys.
marco: need to check billing export shape. If we set project=null, finance needs to accept org-level line items. If not, keep billing to org but avoid attributing to existing projects.
aiops: ops-bot: created ticket INF-5401: "partner sa routing - telemetry + console mapping" and assigned to kai/lina for P2.
marco: rollout plan: dark-launch traces + metric for 48h, FF for 2% orgs for 24h, then widen after finance signoff. add unit/integration tests for partner header precedence.
kai: I'll own the middleware flag and trace attrs. Lina will own console tile and mapping flow. Marco will coordinate finance. Sync tomorrow 10am to review trace samples.
adrian: thanks. dropping sample header to docs: `X-Partner-Integration: partner-acme; X-Redwood-Project: proj-123` - if partner includes both, we keep claim; if only partner header present we route to partner sandbox. good meeting point.
marco: closing for now. :thumbsup:
